p3_b0.ocr: In the intermodal transport volumes analysis for FedEx Corporation covering the years 2020, 2021, and 2022, the Total Volume (TEUs) exhibited a growth from 150,000 in 2020 to 170,000 in 2021, reaching 200,000 in 2022, reflecting a Change of 30,000 TEUs and a % Change of 20%. The Rail Volume (TEUs) increased from 75,000 in 2020 to 90,000 in 2021 and further to 110,000 in 2022, with a Change of 20,000 TEUs and a % Change of 26.67%. The Road Volume (TEUs) rose from 50,000 in 2020 to 55,000 in 2021, and then to 60,000 in 2022, showing a Change of 5,000 TEUs and a % Change of 10%.

p3_b1.ocr: The Sea Volume (TEUs) remained stable at 25,000 in 2020 and 2021, increasing to 30,000 in 2022, resulting in a Change of 5,000 TEUs and a % Change of 20%. Revenue increased from CHF 200M in 2020 to CHF 220M in 2021, and CHF 250M in 2022, with a Change of CHF 30M and a % Change of 15%. Costs grew from CHF 150M in 2020 to CHF 160M in 2021, and CHF 180M in 2022, marking a Change of CHF 20M and a % Change of 13.33%. Profit rose from CHF 50M in 2020 to CHF 60M in 2021, and CHF 70M in 2022 with a Change of CHF 10M and a % Change of 20%.

p3_b3.ocr: Market Share increased from 20% in 2020 to 22% in 2021, reaching 25% in 2022, reflecting a Change of 3% and a % Change of 15%. Customer Satisfaction improved from 85% in 2020 to 87% in 2021 and 90% in 2022, with a Change of 3% and a % Change of 3.53%.

p3_b4.ocr: Finally, On-Time Delivery rates rose from 92% in 2020 to 93% in 2021, and to 95% in 2022, indicating a Change of 2% and a % Change of 2.17%.
